title: billing.invoice.created payload
description: The data payload of the billing.invoice.created event: an invoice is opened. The property `invoice_id` was REMOVED from this payload and its name is reserved by billing's manifest — see x-anywaye-reserved-properties. The removal is stated here as well as in the manifest because a tombstone whose reader cannot check it against the contract it protects is a claim rather than a reservation.

invoice_number.description: The human-facing invoice number. The stable machine identifier is the envelope's subject, so this payload carries no id of its own — the duplication that `invoice_id` was removed for.
